title: Mystical Horned Sorcerer
description: A blue and yellow horned figure with glowing eyes stands in an ancient stone archway covered in runes. He holds an open spellbook in one hand while casting magic with the other, surrounded by floating books, glowing particles, and swirling arcane energy.
prompt: A mystical horned sorcerer with a split blue and yellow face stands inside an ancient stone rune-covered archway. He wears a long beige and red coat with a green cravat, holds an open glowing spellbook in one hand and casts swirling magic with the other. Floating books, glowing particles, rainbow light streaks, and a gnarled magical tree with purple candles fill the background. Mystical atmosphere, detailed digital fantasy art.
